caption: The drawing depicts a stylized human figure with outstretched arms nailed to a cross. The cross is colored in shades of dark brown and gray, with red, yellow, and white decorative panels at each end of the horizontal beam, bearing the letters "B B E." The figure on the cross has pinkish-tan skin accented with bold red and black lines to indicate wounds, muscles, and anatomical features; there are distinct round red marks at the shoulders and other linear marks on the arms, chest, and legs. The head is turned slightly to one side and features a crown of thorns drawn with jagged black strokes, while the hair and beard are outlined in dark brown. The loincloth worn by the figure is beige, decorated with geometric patterns in red, black, and yellow. The front of the lower legs and feet displays stylized red flower-like shapes. The background is plain and uncolored, and the entire composition is centered vertically and horizontally. There is a small number “27” in blue in the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 27: Christ Crucified: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
